name: CoreProjectSetup
intent: A project setup page: a left panel with project context (name, org, tier) and a completion progress card, and a right panel with a recommended next action plus a multi-step SetupStepsChecklist of collapsible setup steps with per-item actions.
when: Guiding a new project (or workspace) through a setup / onboarding flow
The user needs to see completion progress and a step-by-step checklist
A 'get started' page with context on the left and actionable steps on the right
whenNot: An operational dashboard of live metrics -> use a Dashboard / Analytics template
A single record's editable fields -> use a Detail page
A master-detail worklist -> use the Task Monitor template

chooseOver.component: Assembling a progress card + checklist by hand
chooseOver.because: The Project Setup template owns the context sidebar, the progress card, and the SetupStepsChecklist flow.

notes: promotedFrom: apps/web example (ProjectSetupExamplePage) — reflected as a canonical Core template; the example was removed.
